historical_scope: Edo and eastern farming hinterland,1867. May1867fraud notice is source anchor. S054 explicitly flashes back to1845agreement; S055returns1867.
non_graphic_rule: No exposed feces/urine, defecation, toilet users, splashes, flies close-ups or comedic smell clouds. Closed vessels and economic diagrams communicate the subject.
ownership: Money flows from collector/buyer toward landlord or rights holder, not automatically to tenant. Do not conflate producing, owning, collecting and using.

transport.land: Two balanced closed wooden stave buckets on a shoulder pole, or separate horse/handcart depiction. No free-floating buckets or impossible shoulder contact.
transport.water: Plain unpowered wooden river cargo craft with adequate freeboard. Keep boat stable across landing and river views. No exact capacity claim.
transport.legs: S049inbound produce/firewood; other boat scenes outbound fertilizer. Clear editorial labels; no direct food/waste mixing.
transport.capital: Equipment and boats require resources; no assumption every small farmer owns a boat.

source_geometry.bucket: Wooden staves/light hoops grounded in early manual quoted by Tajima. Museum89000246is broadly19th–20thcentury comparative reference, not securely1867.
source_geometry.boat: Text-based generic transport reconstruction. Do not copy a later motorized Kasai boat or label an unverified model as exact.
source_geometry.nagaya: Illustrative shared-privy layout, no claimed excavated household plan; keep water source absent rather than inventing unsafe exact placement.

continuity_links.rule: Detached service enclosure at same courtyard's far-left end.
One doorway of same property, consistent timber/roof/wall forms.
Same vessel as first landing anchor, preserving hull and load arrangement.

fraud.evidence: Koshigaya municipal history quotes May1867notice and reproduces implementing provisions.
fraud.show: Neutral educational water-drop overlay and accounting diagram; no named fictional villain presented as documented.
do_not_claim: Actual arrests occurred in our illustrated case
A specific crop failed due to the depicted load
Exact source quantity units are modern buckets

health: Distinguish economic reuse from sanitary treatment. No DIY dilution/application/fermentation recipe or claim storage kills all pathogens.
wardrobe: Plain indigo-grey private Visitor robe, narrow obi, wearer-left-over-right closure. No mirrored closure, ceremonial pattern, swords, topknot or changed facial features.
acceptance: Trace separate money and material flows without reversing them.
Check closed containers throughout; no accidental gross-out detail.
Check clean produce and fertilizer on separate transport legs and in separate storage.
Do not use the ministry's present-money conversion or loosely dated historical price table.
Match thumbnail promise to landlord rights/value/fraud sections with no image of exposed waste.
